mechanism_narrative: Sustained decline in FEDFUNDS below 2% signals easing monetary policy, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in UNRATE below 4% indicates strengthening labor markets, fostering consumer confidence and corporate investment, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not cross below 4% threshold or 20-day forward returns fail to rise significantly during the trigger period.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in GDPC1 (demand) and INDPRO (supply) reflects robust economic expansion, enhancing corporate earnings and investor optimism, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: The joint rise in GDPC1 and INDPRO does not correlate with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the 60-day horizon.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, rising FEDFUNDS alongside strong GDP growth creates policy uncertainty, dampening equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: In a tightening regime, FEDFUNDS rise with GDPC1 but S&P 500 forward returns remain positive, contradicting the expected negative outcome.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST crossing above 1600 units signals surging demand, stimulating business activity and stock prices, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises > 50 units in a month
failure_condition: HOUST does not cross 1600 units or 5-day forward returns fail to rise significantly during the trigger period.

mechanism_narrative: Rising PAYEMS (labor) and HOUST (demand) jointly indicate healthy employment and consumer spending, amplifying economic momentum and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: The combined rise in PAYEMS and HOUST does not correlate with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the 60-day horizon.

mechanism_narrative: High INDPRO in a late-cycle expansion suggests over-supplied markets, reducing profit margins and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO remains high but S&P 500 forward returns stay positive, indicating the mechanism failed to predict the outcome.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained UNRATE below 5% reflects a tight labor market, boosting productivity and corporate profits, which supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not remain below 5% or 60-day forward returns fail to rise significantly during the sustained period.
